linkedin:
The WordPress REST API exposes your content as JSON under `/wp-json/`, with core routes at `/wp-json/wp/v2/`.

Reading public content needs no auth: a plain `GET /wp/v2/posts` works in the browser. Writing (create, update, delete) needs authentication, and the modern built-in method is **Application Passwords** sent as an HTTP Basic header. For same-origin admin JavaScript, use the cookie plus nonce.
